guidebook.intro: Animals. **Ezayi ambo ovu** (many animals are there) shows **ovu** for “there is”.

tips.title: Ti, indri, kabilo
body: **ti** cow, **indri** goat, **kabilo** sheep, **au** chicken, **otse** dog, **nyau** cat.
**Ma ovu be indri iri** (I have two goats).

tips.title: Simba, ewa, ombuku
body: **simba** lion, **ewa** elephant, **inyiri** snake, **ombuku** crested crane. **Ma ofo inyiri!** (I fear the snake!)

culture.title: Ajai and Murchison
body: West Nile borders the Ajai wildlife reserve and Murchison Falls, where elephants, giraffes and hippos live along the Nile.
